statement: In newly published Indus inscriptions, the twelve-stroke sign G55 is immediately preceded by a fish-family sign (G220 and its marked variants, including the antenna fish G240) more often than the other numeral signs are.
basis: results/g55_fish_im77.md (post hoc: ICIT exploration 30% vs 0-13% per numeral; IM77 21% vs 3.3% pooled).
data: Inscriptions absent from ICIT (as of the project's merged copy) and from IM77, first published after 26 October 2026, any site. Fish family = G220, G222, G226, G230-G236, G240-G244, G940-G944.
statistic: share of G55 tokens with a fish sign right before, minus the same share for all other numeral tokens
test: one-sided Fisher exact, alpha 0.05; evaluate only when at least 5 new G55 tokens with a preceding sign exist
falsified_if: with 5 or more new G55 tokens, the share is not higher than for the other numerals
